faq.q: How is the Linux Master Level 1 exam administered?
faq.a: It has two stages: Part 1 (written) and Part 2 (practical). Part 1 consists of 100 multiple-choice questions with four options in 100 minutes. Part 2 consists of 10 short-answer or essay written questions plus 5 to 7 hands-on practical tasks, in 100 minutes. Part 2 is weighted 40% written and 60% practical.
A score of 60 or higher passes, and scoring below 40% in any subject is an automatic fail. This standard applies to Part 1 and Part 2 separately.

faq.q: How much is the exam fee?
faq.a: Part 1 costs KRW 55,000 and Part 2 costs KRW 77,000. You register and pay for Part 1 and Part 2 separately.

faq.q: How long do I have to take Part 2?
faq.a: Part 1 passers may take Part 2 within 2 years of the results announcement date. Part 1 itself has no eligibility requirements.

There are three subjects: Understanding Practical Linux, Linux System Administration, and Using Linux Networking and Services. The question distribution by subject is not published in the official notice.
